ActivateLicense.description_en: Activates an authorization code by calling ActivateLicense
ActivateLicense.description_zh: 调用 ActivateLicense 激活授权码

ConfirmNotification.description_en: Confirms that the merchant has received and processed a notification message. After this call, the message will no longer be returned in subsequent queries
ConfirmNotification.description_zh: 商家查收完毕通知信息之后调用此接口反馈给平台，后续该信息不会再被查询出来

CreateOrder.description_en:
Calls the CreateOrder operation to create an order.

Before calling this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing method and pricing of Alibaba Cloud Marketplace products.

To create an order for a commercial image, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25499.html
CreateOrder.description_zh:
调用 CreateOrder 创建订单。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解云市场产品的收费方式和价格。

商业镜像创建订单接口请参考 CreateInstance

CrossAccountVerifyToken.description_en: Query cross-account role authorization information, including the authorized user's Alibaba Cloud account UID, name, authorization time, and authorized role name
CrossAccountVerifyToken.description_zh: 查询跨账号角色授权信息，包含授权人阿里云账号UID、名称、授权时间、授权角色名称

DescribeApiMetering.description_en: Retrieves the API quota data of a user, including the remaining quota, total quota, and usage
DescribeApiMetering.description_zh: 获取用户的API余量、总量、使用量等数据

DescribeCurrentNodeInfo.description_en: Calls DescribeCurrentNodeInfo to retrieve the process information of the current node
DescribeCurrentNodeInfo.description_zh: 调用DescribeCurrentNodeInfo获取当前节点的流程信息

DescribeDistributionProducts.description_en: Retrieves a paginated list of promotional products with detailed information
DescribeDistributionProducts.description_zh: 分页获取推广商品列表及详细信息

DescribeDistributionProductsLink.description_en: Retrieves promotion links for promoted products
DescribeDistributionProductsLink.description_zh: 获取推广商品的推广链接

DescribeFailedNotifications.description_en: Queries the list of failed subscription notifications. After Alibaba Cloud Marketplace fails to call a service provider's message SPI, the service provider can use this operation to proactively query the failed notification information
DescribeFailedNotifications.description_zh: 查询订阅通知失败列表，云市场调用商家消息SPI失败后，商家可以通过此接口主动查询出失败的信息

DescribeInstance.description_en: Calls the DescribeInstance operation to query instance information
DescribeInstance.description_zh: 调用 DescribeInstance 查询实例信息

DescribeInstanceForIsv.description_en: Queries instance information from the service provider side
DescribeInstanceForIsv.description_zh: 服务商侧查询实例信息

DescribeInstances.description_en: Queries the list of services purchased by the user
DescribeInstances.description_zh: 查询用户已购买的服务列表

DescribeInvoiceForIsv.description_en: Queries the invoice information of a supplier store in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace
DescribeInvoiceForIsv.description_zh: 查询云市场供应商店铺的发票信息

DescribeLicense.description_en: Calls DescribeLicense to query license information
DescribeLicense.description_zh: 调用 DescribeLicense 查询授权信息

DescribeOrder.description_en: Queries the details of a specified order
DescribeOrder.description_zh: 调用 DescribeOrder 用于查询对应订单的详细信息

DescribeOrderForIsv.description_en: Queries order details from the service provider side
DescribeOrderForIsv.description_zh: 服务商侧查询订单详情

DescribePrice.description_en: Calls DescribePrice to query the price information of the corresponding product
DescribePrice.description_zh: 调用 DescribePrice 查询对应商品的价格信息

DescribeProduct.description_en: Queries the details of a specified product by calling DescribeProduct
DescribeProduct.description_zh: 调用 DescribeProduct 用于查询指定商品的详细信息

DescribeProducts.description_en: Retrieves a list of products that meet the specified conditions along with their details
DescribeProducts.description_zh: 调用 DescribeProducts 拉取符合条件的商品列表及详细信息

DescribeProjectAttachments.description_en: Calls DescribeProjectAttachments to retrieve the list of project attachments
DescribeProjectAttachments.description_zh: 调用DescribeProjectAttachments获取项目附件列表

DescribeProjectInfo.description_en: Calls DescribeProjectInfo to query project information

DescribeProjectMessages.description_en: Calls DescribeProjectMessages to retrieve the list of project workflow messages
DescribeProjectMessages.description_zh: 调用DescribeProjectMessages获取项目流程留言信息列表

DescribeProjectNodes.description_en: Queries the list of project flow nodes by calling DescribeProjectNodes
DescribeProjectNodes.description_zh: 调用DescribeProjectNodes获取项目流程节点列表

DescribeProjectOperateLogs.description_en: Calls DescribeProjectOperateLogs to retrieve the operation logs of a project flow
DescribeProjectOperateLogs.description_zh: 调用DescribeProjectOperateLogs获取项目流程操作日志

FinishCurrentProjectNode.description_en: Completes the current process by calling FinishCurrentProjectNode

PauseProject.description_en: Calls PauseProject to pause a project

PushMeteringData.description_en: Call PushMeteringData to push metering data

PushTimesUsage.description_en: Pushes usage deduction for a prepaid per-use product to Alibaba Cloud Marketplace on behalf of a service provider
PushTimesUsage.description_zh: 用于服务商向云市场推送用户预付费按次计费商品的使用次数扣减

ResumeProject.description_en: Calls ResumeProject to resume a paused project

RollbackCurrentProjectNode.description_en: Triggers a rejection of the current process node by calling RollbackCurrentProjectNode
RollbackCurrentProjectNode.description_zh: 调用RollbackCurrentProjectNode触发当前流程驳回
